about: Holly`s Hunt is a duel shooter game.
You choose between 5 types of weapons to attack. Your goal is to attack the enemy in a limited amount of time with the required type of weapon.
The attack is activated on the same button as the selection of this weapon type. You score points for each timely and correct attack.
The game is over when you spend three live points choosing the wrong type of weapon or failing to activate an attack within the time limit.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
